title: LOT & GARAGE SAFETY
description: Speed limits, pedestrian awareness, and movement protocols in ready lines and structured parking.

questions.prompt: The maximum speed in any structured garage or ready line is 5 mph.
questions.explanation: Tight aisles, blind corners, and frequent pedestrians make 5 mph the standard ceiling across all rental operations.

questions.prompt: You are pulling out of a stall and a customer is walking behind a row of cars two spaces over. What should you do?

options.text: Honk to alert them and continue
Stop, make eye contact, and wait until they pass behind you
Speed up to clear the area before they reach you
Reverse faster — they will see the brake lights

questions.explanation: Pedestrians always have right of way in the lot. Stop, make eye contact, confirm they see you, and let them pass.
